scoring_justification: Phonon frequencies are compared to experimental reference via mean absolute error; re-computing the dynamical matrix in the verifier is infeasible, so result-level comparison is used.

outputs.description: Phonon frequencies of germanium along high-symmetry directions, computed using the pseudo-atom model with exchange-correlation. The frequencies are compared against a hidden reference (experimental data) within a tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The checker computes mean absolute error per branch against a hidden experimental reference. All frequencies must be real (no imaginary part).

steps.description: Compare phonon frequencies against experimental reference using MAE.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden reference phonon frequencies at high-symmetry points from Nilsson and Nelin (1971)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's Figure 3 experimental data from Nilsson and Nelin, Phys. Rev. B 3, 364 (1971), as quoted in the paper text.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's textual description of experimental measurements; values are Gamma, X, L frequencies.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The values are the actual experimental phonon frequencies reported in the paper, used to evaluate the model's accuracy.
